Players Committee card image of [[Droid Racks (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Use 4 Force to deploy on table. While present with a Jedi, destroyer droids are defense value +2. If your destroyer droid was just lost, may stack it here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to play any destroyer droid here in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/droidracks.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
